_comment: Template for shared/finance/paths.json — copy it, fill in your own paths, and note that the real file is gitignored. Everything below is INVENTED. This repo is public: the DOMAIN (code, categories, rules) is shared, the WORK (where your statements live, which accounts you have) stays on your machine.

planning_workbook._comment: Your top-level planning document. READ ONLY — nothing in this repo ever writes to it. It supplies the categories, the subscription list, the savings rate.

boat_workbook._comment: Optional second workbook for a cross-cutting subject. Also READ ONLY, and a touchstone: the total from the ledger has to match it.

collect_from._comment: Folders tidy pulls into root, keeping their sub-structure. Left the source, right the folder name under root.

accounts_from_filename._comment: Statement files are sorted into Konten/<account> by what their file name contains. These are IBAN fragments and card names, which is why they live here.

out_of_scope_targets._comment: Where tidy proposes to move the work folders named in shared/finance.json → tidy.out_of_scope.names. It never touches their contents, and ingest never reads from there.

accounts.label: Girokonto
accounts._comment: dialect names the parser in workflows/finance/statements.py. Never put an IBAN in a file that is not gitignored.
